title: Umbral methods, function factorisation and generalisation of the Fourier transform method
summary: We propose a systematic way to construct trigonometric-like functions beyond the classical sine--cosine pair by factorising rational umbral operators. The guiding idea is simple: the usual trigonometric functions may be viewed as cyclic components arising from a finite factorisation, and the same principle can be extended to an $n$-fold decomposition of rational umbral expressions.
